subject: Request: access evidence & SCIM test plan for SIG
messages:
From: Jane Durand <jane.durand@acme-fin.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-fin.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up — access controls evidence (SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA)

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the demo last week. Our security team is working through the SIG questionnaire and requested additional evidence for access controls: SSO metadata, SCIM provisioning logs/tests, RBAC mapping documentation, and MFA enforcement proof for admin roles.

Can you share the current SIG answers and any artifacts we can attach (screenshots, SAML metadata, SCIM test plan)? We have a tight deadline to submit by end of this week.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — if helpful, we can schedule a short sync.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Durand
Director, IT Security | Acme Financial

Team — forwarding Acme's request below. They need: SSO metadata, SCIM provisioning logs/test plan, RBAC mapping doc, and MFA proof for admin accounts. Deadline end of week (Friday).

Soojin — can you pull the SCIM test plan and a couple of provisioning screenshots? Laura — can you confirm where we keep MFA enforcement reports for enterprise customers and whether we can generate a short admin-login audit extract? Monica — I'll own the external reply and packaging.

I'll consolidate and send to Jane after QA. If anything is sensitive, flag and we'll route through legal.

Rafael

Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG follow-up — access controls evidence (SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA)

Rafael / team — pulling together artifacts now. Quick notes: 
- SCIM: I have the provisioning test plan (internal) and a recent provisioning run for Acme's test SCIM user (provisioning-log-20270210.csv). I'll export a sanitized CSV and a screenshot of the successful user create in the admin console.
- SSO: SAML metadata file and a short step-by-step showing SSO config page are available. (I'll attach the metadata xml.)
- RBAC: We maintain role-to-permission mapping in Confluence. I can export a scoped excerpt that shows Admin, OrgAdmin, and ReadOnly mappings relevant to Acme's needs.
- MFA: Enforcement is via conditional policy; I can generate an audit extract showing admin authentication events with 2FA status for the past 90 days.

Two questions before I ship: 1) Do we need raw logs or redacted/sanitized versions? 2) Any Acme-specific naming we should mask?

I'll aim to have the first bundle by EOD Wednesday.

Soojin
Senior Identity Engineer, Redwood Inference

attachment: scim-provisioning-testplan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG follow-up — access controls evidence (SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA)

Soojin / Rafael — we can provide a sanitized MFA admin audit extract. I'll pull the authentication events CSV for admin-role accounts and redact IP addresses per our data-sharing policy.

For RBAC mapping, instead of full Confluence export, I'll create a one-page role mapping PDF that lists: role name, scope (org/team), key permissions (user management, billing, model deployment), and control comments (least-privilege guidance). That should be easier for Acme to consume.

FYI — legal asked we include the SOC 2 section reference (CC6) when we submit the SIG artifacts; I'll add a short note in the package.

Laura
Security & Compliance Manager
--
attachment: role-mapping-onepage.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Durand <jane.durand@acme-fin.com>, Acme Security <security@acme-fin.com>

Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — access controls evidence (SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA)

Hi Jane — thanks for the patience. Please find attached the initial bundle of artifacts for Acme's SIG review: 
- redwood_sig_answers_v1.pdf (completed SIG answers, access-controls section highlighted)
- sso-metadata.xml (SAML metadata)
- scim-provisioning-testplan.xlsx (test steps and results)
- scim-provisioning-screenshot.png (admin console confirmation)
- role-mapping-onepage.pdf (RBAC summary)

Notes: 
- We sanitized logs and redacted IP addresses where required (per our data-sharing policy).
- MFA enforcement: Laura attached a short admin-audit CSV to our internal folder; we included a summarized snippet in the SIG answers referencing CC6 as requested. If you need the raw audit for a compliance review, we'll need an executed DPA addendum — happy to coordinate with your legal team.

Next steps: let me know if you need any clarifications or additional artifacts (e.g., SCIM provisioning webhook payloads, full SAML trace). Happy to run a 20-minute handoff call with Soojin and Laura this Thursday if that helps.

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — access controls evidence (SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA)

Rafael / team — received, thank you. The bundle looks good and covers our initial asks. A couple of quick follow-ups from the security review: 
- Can you confirm retention windows for SCIM provisioning logs? (we're documenting proof that provisions are retained for 90 days)
- For RBAC, can you indicate whether the Admin role requires MFA by policy or only via conditional rules?

If you can answer those two points and share the short admin-audit snippet referenced, we should be able to close the SIG section. A 20-minute sync on Thursday 10am PT would be ideal if Laura and Soojin can join.

Thanks — Jane
